content.help: Master switch. When off, the overlay does nothing and outfits are no longer re-asserted.
Corner notifications for actions (e.g. 'Equipped: Iron Cuirass').

content.text: Look at a follower and press F4 to open the wardrobe overlay, then tick items to dress them. (Requires the PrismaUI framework.)

content.help: Immediately re-apply the saved outfit to every nearby managed follower. Use if someone looks wrong after a script-heavy event.
Stop managing every follower. They keep what they are wearing now, but the mod no longer re-asserts it. Use before uninstalling.

content.text: Follower managers: if you use NFF/EFF/AFT outfit management on a follower, turn it off for that follower before dressing them here, or the two systems will fight.
